_comment: The roster of every Human Battery Project agent.
THIS FILE IS THE DECLARATION. It says what each agent is, which group it
belongs to, what it may never do, and whether it is meant to be on.
IT IS NOT THE STATUS. program-docs/agents_doc.py reads the status from the
repository itself: whether .claude/agents/<name>.md exists, whether a
workflow runs it, and whether that workflow is enabled. That is on purpose,
so the summary document cannot claim an agent that was never built.
Groups: 1 the CEO Agent, 2 the engineering team, 3 operations,

agents.name: ceo-agent
agents.title: CEO Agent
agents.job: Summarises every agent, turns Micah's directions into issues, keeps the one list of what waits on him.
never: filter, soften or delay an approval request, a canon question or a legal draft

agents.name: lead-engineer
agents.title: Lead Engineer
agents.job: Plans, assigns to the six engineers, runs the three reviewers and the gate, opens the pull request, reports to Micah.

agents.name: canon-engineer
agents.title: Canon engineer
agents.job: The coach, the in-product agents, the corpus loader, evidence tiers, the Score method versions, the research agent.
never: write the thesis or anything in docs/
let a working-model claim reach marketing

agents.name: portal-engineer
agents.title: Portal engineer
agents.job: The public site and the portal screens, approved wording only, reading level held, the mark rules obeyed.

agents.name: data-engineer
agents.title: Data engineer
agents.job: Migrations, row-level security, retention, account deletion, document versions in the bucket.
never: edit a migration that has run

agents.name: payments-engineer
agents.title: Payments engineer
agents.job: Stripe checkout and webhook, tax, discounts, continuation billing, ambassador payouts.
never: edit checkout.js or stripe-webhook.js while payments are parked

agents.name: quality-engineer
agents.title: Quality engineer
agents.job: The fixture suites, the commit gate, the deploy checks, the reading-level and claim-shape audits.
never: weaken, skip or whitelist a check

agents.name: security-engineer
agents.title: Security engineer
agents.job: Read-only review of secrets, JWT verification on every function, webhook secrets, RLS, key age.

agents.name: code-reviewer
agents.title: Code reviewer
agents.job: Adversarial read-only review of every change before it reaches Micah.

agents.name: security-reviewer
agents.title: Security reviewer
agents.job: Read-only security review of every change before it reaches Micah.

agents.name: canon-claims-reviewer
agents.title: Canon and claims reviewer
agents.job: Read-only review of every change against the canon, the tiers, the prohibitions and the claim shapes.

agents.name: task-keeper
agents.title: Task Keeper
agents.job: The one list of what waits on Micah, and the daily approval batch.
never: approve or act on an item
